Warm-ups that work

Plain-words guides

No jargon, no guru talk. Just what works when you're learning on your own, in a flat, after work.

Keep the instrument where you can see it.

Out of sight is out of practice. A guitar on a stand gets played ten times more than one in a case under the bed.

Your data stays yours

Everything lives in this browser only — no account, no uploads. Copy a summary to share with a teacher or a friend, or wipe it clean and start over.
